note: Thayer County publishes its zoning map only as a static draft PDF (April 2024); village zoning regulations are PDFs and Hebron's zoning map is a PDF. The county GIS portal (thayer.nebraskaassessors.com) exposes no zoning layer. The only queryable zoning-named layer found, an ArcGIS Online personal item by webgeeks (ThayerNE_Zoning, 23 polygons, field District, sample values 'Flex Corridor'), does not match the county's district codes and appears to be a planning layer, so I did not submit it.
